title: Implement ingestion: adapters → store, read-only, dedup, lossless round-trip
description:
**Files:** `src/store/ingest.rs` (new), `src/store/mod.rs`, `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`. No src/adapters or src/cli changes.

**Specs turned green:** `05_ingest.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** `Store::ingest(&adapters) -> IngestReport`: per adapter discover(), then per session open() and one transaction — sessions row (projected columns + `session_json` minus messages + sha256 `content_hash` over the canonical session JSON), messages rows (`message_json` + projected columns), parts rows (kind + text projection), FTS rows for text-bearing parts. First-report-wins dedup within a pass. Optional-embedder hook: an `Option<Arc<dyn Embedder>>` configured on the store is called at ingest to produce session embeddings into the vec0 table (no default embedder yet — the seam lands with the search epic; store the model id in `meta` and refuse a mismatched one). Sources stay read-only by construction — the adapters have no write surface; the digest steps prove it. Round-trip equality holds for every fixtures-corpus session.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Heads-up from the sessions-listing bug run: the chapter-1 dedupe rule in SessionStore::list_sessions (src/session.rs) silently drops transcripts when the same session id appears in two project dirs (observed 63→61 on real data; bug BOTSPY-17e4aad9). The fix keys dedupe on (agent, id, project_id). When you implement first-report-wins ingestion here, please adopt the same keying so the store matches the fixed listing rule.
